defect: a parameterised reset synchronizer is instantiated with only one release stage
rationale: The generic supports a safe two-stage default, but this instance explicitly selects DEPTH=1, so reset_ni is released from the first metastability-catching stage.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

mutation.description: Configured a reusable reset synchronizer with a single stage instead of the required minimum depth of two.

labels.note: DEPTH=1 leaves only the metastability-catching stage to release consumer reset.
